Read the on-screen controls as named ele:
Read the on-screen controls as named elements with refs, instead of measuring pixels in a screenshot. Prefer this over screenshot whenever it returns anything: clicking ref_7 'Don't Save' hits the button wherever it is, while clicking a coordinate measured off an image is a guess.
scope: 'focused' (default, the active window), 'windows' (every top-level window, each with a ref you can focus), 'window:<hwnd>', or 'ref:<ref>' for a window you already listed. filter='all' includes structural elements as well, and query='Save' returns only elements whose name or value contains that text -- worth using on a file manager or a browser, where a full read easily hits the limit.
Each element reports role, name, value, rectangle, centre and the actions it supports. Pass a ref to the element tool, or to mouse(ref=...).
Windows that expose no accessibility tree -- Electron and custom-drawn applications, Unity, games -- are handled here rather than by you: their on-screen text is recognised and returned as elements too, marked source='ocr'. Those carry a name read from pixels, so it can be wrong, icon-only controls are missing entirely, and only clicking works on them. Read the 'note' field, and reach for screenshot only when even that finds nothing.
Reading works on a window that is covered by other windows, and on one that is not focused. If a window cannot be captured at all it is brought forward so the answer is complete, and the note says so -- which is why this tool is not marked read-only. A minimised window has neither a tree nor pixels: restore it first. Requires an open control session.

List all available Alibaba Cloud product:
List all available Alibaba Cloud products.

This tool retrieves a comprehensive list of Alibaba Cloud products.
It's useful for:
- Discovering available Alibaba Cloud products and services
- Finding the product code needed for other API calls (e.g., ListApis)
- Understanding the product landscape of Alibaba Cloud
- Searching for products by keyword

Parameters:
- filter (optional): A keyword to filter products by code, name, shortName, group, or category
  Examples: "Ecs", "Computing", "Storage", "Database", "Networking"

Returns:
A list of Alibaba Cloud products, each containing:
- code: Product code (e.g., "EhpcInstant", "Ecs")
- name: Product display name (e.g., "E-HPC Instant", "Elastic Compute Service (ECS)")
- description: Product description
- shortName: Short name of the product (e.g., "E-HPC Instant")
- group: Product group (e.g., "Elastic Computing", "Storage")
- style: API style (e.g., "RPC", "ROA")
- versions: Available API versions (e.g., ["2023-07-01"])
- defaultVersion: Default API version (e.g., "2023-07-01")
- categoryName: Category name (e.g., "High Performance Computing")
- category2Name: Secondary category name (e.g., "Computing")

The results can be filtered by the optional filter parameter to narrow down the list to products matching specific keywords.

Example usage:
1. List all products: no parameters needed
2. List products related to computing: filter="Computing"
3. List products related to ECS: filter="Ecs"
4. List products related to storage: filter="Storage"
Search Alibaba Cloud official documentat:
Search Alibaba Cloud official documentation. When a user's question involves any Alibaba Cloud product usage, configuration, operation steps, error troubleshooting, API/SDK, billing, or best practices, call this tool first instead of a general web search — it returns authoritative official content.

Returns a list of matching documents (doc_id/title/url/content). Use the doc_id or url with AlibabaCloud___GetDocument to fetch the full document body.

Parameters:
- query (required): Search keyword or phrase, max 100 characters
  Examples: "ECS instance creation", "OSS bucket policy", "VPC peering", "RDS backup"
- limit (optional, default: 5): Maximum number of documents to return. Valid range: 1-20
- product (optional): Restrict search to a specific product. Accepts product code, English short name, or Chinese name (e.g. "oss", "OSS", or the Chinese name for Object Storage Service). The server normalizes the input automatically.
- website (optional, default: cn): Site to search. "cn" for Chinese site, "intl" for international site.
- language (optional, default: zh): Document language. Values: zh, en, tc, ja, id, pt-br.

Example usage:
1. Search for ECS documentation: query="ECS instance"
2. Search with product filter: query="cross-origin CORS", product="oss"
3. Search international docs: query="OSS access control", website="intl", language="en"

[Project Management] Create a work item.
Description field guidance:
- description supports Markdown or rich text and must be paired with formatType ("MARKDOWN" or "RICHTEXT").
- To insert images in the description: (1) Create the work item with this tool; description may initially be empty or contain a placeholder. (2) Call create_workitem_attachment to upload the image and obtain embedMarkdown or embedHtml from the result. (3) Call update_work_item to write back the assembled description. Do not use the url field returned by create_workitem_attachment: it is a temporary signed OSS URL that expires after 30 seconds.
- Actual effort (fieldId 101587) and estimated effort (fieldId 101586) are Yunxiao-controlled system fields and cannot be modified through this tool's customFieldValues. Use `create_effort_record` / `create_estimated_effort` instead.
[Project Management] Update a work item.
Argument structure: except for organizationId and workItemId, every field to update must be placed inside updateWorkItemFields, including subject, description, formatType, status, assignedTo, priority, labels, sprint, trackers, verifier, participants, versions, and customFieldValues.
To embed an image in the description, first call create_workitem_attachment and obtain embedMarkdown (formatType="MARKDOWN") or embedHtml (formatType="RICHTEXT"). Insert that value into updateWorkItemFields.description and set updateWorkItemFields.formatType to the corresponding format. Do not embed the returned url in the description: it is a temporary signed OSS URL that expires after 30 seconds.
Controlled fields: actual effort (fieldId 101587) and estimated effort (fieldId 101586) are system-controlled fields in Alibaba Cloud DevOps and cannot be changed through updateWorkItemFields.customFieldValues. Use create_effort_record/update_effort_record and create_estimated_effort/update_estimated_effort instead.

[Project Management] Upload a file as an: [Project Management] Upload a file as an attachment to a work item via multipart/form-data. Supports any file type except svg/tiff, which Alibaba Cloud DevOps does not support. Each file must be no larger than 10 MB. Choose one file source: - Remote deployment (Streamable HTTP): provide fileContent (the file contents encoded as base64) and fileName (including the extension). The server and caller usually run on different machines, so the server cannot read the caller's local files; inline base64 content is required. - Local deployment on the same machine, including stdio: provide filePath (an absolute path) for the server to read directly. fileName is optional and defaults to the path's basename. filePath is disabled for remote deployments because it refers to the server's filesystem and would permit arbitrary file reads; use fileContent instead. The returned WorkitemFile includes these key fields: - id/name/size/suffix: basic file information. - url: a temporary OSS download URL that expires in about 30 seconds. Use it only for downloading; do not embed it in work item descriptions or comments. - embedUrl: a permanent proxy URL for embedding images in work item descriptions or comments. - embedMarkdown: a ready-to-use Markdown image tag; append it to description when formatType=MARKDOWN. - embedHtml: a ready-to-use HTML tag; append it to description when formatType=RICHTEXT. To insert an image into a work item description: (1) create the work item, unless it already exists; (2) upload the image with this tool and read embedMarkdown or embedHtml; (3) call update_work_item, inserting that embed* value into updateWorkItemFields.description and setting updateWorkItemFields.formatType to "MARKDOWN" or "RICHTEXT" accordingly. operatorId is required with an application token and may be omitted with a personal token.
